findings.summary: The new rc1 refinalization test fails on the repository's own CI checkout because the finalizer requires the frozen gate-k-rc1 commit d8a0b85 to exist in local git history, while actions/checkout defaults to a depth-1 shallow clone (verify.yml sets no fetch-depth).
findings.evidence: Reproduced in a depth-1 clone (`git clone --depth 1 file://...`) of HEAD: `docs/evaluation/test-gate-k-rc1-refinalization.sh` exits 1 with `gate-k eval finalizer: FAIL: candidate commit is absent from repository history: .../2026-08-23-gemini-3.7-flash-author/subject-task`, triggered by the `git cat-file -e d8a0b85^{commit}` check at gate-k-eval-finalize.sh:631. Since verify.yml runs `docs/evaluation/test-gate-k-eval-tooling.sh` (line 66) and that script now sources the rc1 refinalization test at line 8, the CI proof lane fails at this HEAD; the portability repairs in 202a308/75a08b5 (skipping live provider-extension and bwrap reads for the four frozen receipts) do not cover object-history availability.

findings.summary: The preserved revision-6 rehearsal adjudications cannot pass the repository's own adjudication validator or finalizer at their claimed tooling head (cbfa3f7) or at HEAD, because the run-root layout omits the required per-role records (plan.json, packet-manifest.json, prompt.txt, transcript.ndjson, commands.json) inside subject/, so the documented 'the finalizer derived each overall pass' claim is not re-derivable from the preserved evidence.
findings.evidence: `python3 docs/evaluation/gate-k-eval-validate-adjudication.py <run>/subject <run>/checker <run>/adjudication.json` fails immediately with 'cannot read docs/evaluation/runs/rehearsal/2026-08-24-gemini-author-deepseek-checker-r6/subject/packet-manifest.json' (same for the debug pair); the cbfa3f7 version of the validator and finalizer require plan.json in each role record (gate-k-eval-finalize.sh:64). The adjudication's per-dimension evidence hashes do match the preserved files when resolved run-root-relative, so the records are internally hash-consistent but not tool-verifiable in their committed shape, contrary to GATE_K_COLD_AGENT_PLAN.md's 'the finalizer derived each overall pass' and HANDOFF.md's mechanical-pass claim.

findings.summary: No exact-schema allowlist validator exists for the revision-6 final records nomos.gate_k.checker_receipt@2 and nomos.gate_k.run_result@2, so the 'allowlisted ... final-result records' requirement is enforced only by the finalizer's fixed jq template and two ad hoc jq assertions rather than by a schema validator like those for plan/manifest/task-receipt/checker-result/adjudication.
findings.evidence: grep across docs/evaluation shows run_result@2/checker_receipt@2 referenced only in gate-k-eval-finalize.sh and one jq check in test-gate-k-eval-tooling.sh; gate-k-eval-validate-documents.py main() accepts only plan, manifest, task-receipt, and checker-result kinds; no validator or test asserts the complete key allowlist of the generated checker.json (checker_receipt@2) or result.json (run_result@2), so a malformed revision-6 final result would be accepted and committed unchecked.
